title: 'N MCP servers unavailable' note lands after the user's first prompt
observed: The failure note from the background connect committed below a prompt the user sent during startup
expected: Note where the user sees it

fix.note: Chronological: the connect finished after the prompt was sent. Servers now connect concurrently (f69f765), so the note arrives within one connect timeout of startup; moving it above the prompt would misstate when it happened.
